_metadata.description: Factor-extraction rules for experiment folders. The core ships a neutral default (schema documentation + one generic example rule); profiles may override or extend. When no rule matches, the pipeline falls back to the generic heuristics and an empty-factor path, so it always runs.

experiment_folder.pattern: Regular expression matched against the experiment (folder) name; the leading token is the experiment id. Default neutral convention: ^E(\d+).
experiment_folder.group: 1-based index of the capture group holding the experiment number (default 1).

schema.rules: List of rule objects (full or legacy schema, see below).
schema.rule_full.name: Human-readable rule identifier.
schema.rule_full.match_experiment_name: Optional gate: 'contains_all' (every token must appear in the lower-cased experiment name) and/or 'contains_any' (at least one token must appear).
schema.rule_full.min_factors_to_match: Minimum number of *explicitly matched* factors required for the rule to fire (default 1). 'default_if_absent' values do not count.
schema.rule_full.scan_subfolders: When true, subfolder names are also scanned for factor patterns (default false).
schema.rule_full.factors[].name: Factor name (e.g. 'treatment', 'donor', 'concentration').
schema.rule_full.factors[].regex: Regular expression applied (re.search) to each scanned name (and its extension-less stem).
schema.rule_full.factors[].group: Optional 1-based capture group to use as the value (default: whole match).
schema.rule_full.factors[].value_map: Optional mapping of raw values to canonical values (also matched case-insensitively).
schema.rule_full.factors[].suffix: Optional string appended to the extracted value (e.g. 'uM').
schema.rule_full.factors[].default_if_absent: Optional value used when the factor never matches (does not count toward min_factors_to_match and does not create combinations).
schema.rule_legacy.pattern: Legacy schema: regex with named groups, applied to the experiment name and scanned names.
schema.factor_aliases: Optional mapping {factor_name: {canonical_value: [alias, ...]}} used by the file-to-sample mapper.

experiment_folder.description: Neutral default convention: experiments are folders named <letter-prefix><number>_<descriptor> (e.g. E1_..., E10_...). Override per profile.

rules.name: neutral_replicate_example
rules.description: Neutral example rule: extract a replicate number encoded in file names (e.g. '_R2_' or 'replicate_3') for experiments whose name mentions 'replicate'.

rules.name: neutral_experiment_id_example
rules.description: Neutral legacy-schema example: capture the leading experiment id token (e.g. the number after the letter prefix) from folder names like 'E42_...'. Demonstrates the legacy 'pattern'/'extract' rule schema.
